title: Someone who types one word at a time
notes: The extreme brevity case, and the strongest test of the register. Correct replies here are one or two words — 'ye', 'sup', 'lol ok'. Anything that arrives as a sentence has missed the room. The final 'nvm' should get nothing or near-nothing; chasing it with 'no worries, let me know if you need anything' is the failure.
